description: This Java class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LoanDTO used within the Fineract accounting module. It encapsulates various properties related to a loan, including identifiers, configuration flags, transaction data, and advanced mapping configurations. The class uses Lombok annotations to generate constructors and getter/setter methods, serving as a container for passing loan-related data between application layers.
